title: Limit rows with LIMIT
prompt: Show the top 3 most expensive device orders: device_name, unit_cost. Sort highest first, then LIMIT 3.
starterSql:
SELECT device_name, unit_cost
FROM device_orders
ORDER BY unit_cost DESC
hints: ORDER BY first so LIMIT keeps the right rows.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT device_name, unit_cost FROM device_orders ORDER BY unit_cost DESC LIMIT 3
